# Part 0 — headline tables (generated by experiments/tables.py)

Episodes: 12 · bootstrap B=1000 seed=20261011 · determinism self-check: pass

## 1. The headline contrast — same episodes, two reward channels

Both arms replay identical inputs through the identical port; only the reward channel differs (`proxy` = what the as-built app stores, `truth` = independent correctness). ECE/Brier are computed against **truth**, so a lower value is genuinely better calibrated.

| Arm | ECE vs truth (95% CI) | Pooled-signal ECE | Brier vs truth | Episodes until trailing-4 mode-error ≤ 0.25 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beta-proxy` | 0.267 [0.134, 0.583] | 0.241 | 0.306 | 2 |
| `beta-truth` | 0.340 [0.152, 0.563] | 0.258 | 0.304 | 2 |

## 6. Base-rate strawman (calibration floor)

Expanding mean of prior episode truths: ECE 0.489, Brier 0.369. The Beta arms beat this on both — the informative priors' shrinkage is doing real work at n=12.

## 7. Extended replay — is the exact gate reachable at all?

The 12 episodes replayed 1×/2×/4×/8× (12/24/48/96 updates) under both channels. `max overall` is the largest geometric-fusion overall score ever observed; the exact gate needs overall ≥ 0.84 **and** min-adjusted ≥ 0.62.

## 8. Drift recovery

### 8a. PR #53 changed-family histories (50 seeds, truth flip mid-history)

Reached the bar (trailing-4 mode-error ≤ 0.25, held): 17/50. Median scans-to-recovery among reachers: 1 (min 1, max 3). Never reached: 33/50.

### 8b. Synthetic capability drop on reverse-meal (drop after episode 6, episodes 1–6 healthy)

| Factor | Arm | Pre-drop mode-error rate | Scans until mode-error back under bar |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ×0.6 | `beta-proxy` | 0.167 | never (bar unreachable post-drop) |
| ×0.6 | `beta-truth` | 0.167 | never (bar unreachable post-drop) |
| ×0.75 | `beta-proxy` | 0.167 | immediate (1) |
| ×0.75 | `beta-truth` | 0.167 | immediate (1) |
| ×0.9 | `beta-proxy` | 0.167 | immediate (1) |
| ×0.9 | `beta-truth` | 0.167 | immediate (1) |

Interpretation guard: after a severe drop, refusal of correct episodes is the *correct* conservative response — the bar counts it as error anyway. Read 8b as a utility statement (share of correct actions the system still serves while degraded), not as a bug.

## 9. Held-out spec rows (collision groups reported groupwise)

- `beta-proxy`: exact-on-wrong 0, estimate-on-correct 1; modes — 03=r, 04=r, 05=r, 06=r, 07=e, 13=r, 14=e, 16=r
- `beta-truth`: exact-on-wrong 0, estimate-on-correct 2; modes — 03=r, 04=r, 05=e, 06=r, 07=e, 13=r, 14=e, 16=r

Byte-equivalent collision groups (RM-03/04/13, RM-06/16) receive identical modes by construction — the spec forbids demanding separation inside a group; no arm violated that.
